REWORK ITERATION 1: WF-03 Step 2 rework for ISS-0705, scoped ONLY to design doc lib/letflow/design/iss0705-sandbox-mode-restore-fix.md's Section 1 (tenants_test.exs fix). Sections 2 and 3 (identity_test.exs, role_registry_test.exs) are verified correct and already implemented/passing -- do NOT touch them or ask ELIXIR-DEV to redo them.

On branch feature/WF03-ISS0705-20260917 (`git checkout feature/WF03-ISS0705-20260917`; the branch already has the correct §2/§3 changes committed at 9fcd5fcb -- do not revert them).

Read handoffs/WF03-ISS0705-20260917/step-03-elixir-dev.json's result.summary and result.issues in full: ELIXIR-DEV applied §1's design exactly (wrap the real-provisioning test body in `Letflow.Test.SandboxAutoMode.provision!/2`) and it fails with `DBConnection.OwnershipError: cannot find ownership process ... using mode :manual`. Root cause: `provision!/2`'s own `after` block restores :manual mode + a fresh checkout owned by the TEST process as soon as the wrapped fn returns -- but this test's own `on_exit/1` (registered INSIDE the wrapped fn, doing DROP SCHEMA/delete_all cleanup) only runs LATER, from ExUnit's separate OnExitHandler process, by which point the :manual-mode connection is checked out to a process (the original test process) that no longer owns anything from OnExitHandler's perspective.

Design a fix for this specific gap. Two directions worth considering (pick whichever is more correct and simpler -- your call, state your reasoning): (a) restructure so the test's on_exit/1 callback is registered OUTSIDE the provision!/2-wrapped closure (i.e. call provision!/2 only around the narrower DDL/migration-replay segment that actually needs :auto mode, register on_exit separately at the top level of the test as before); (b) have the on_exit/1 callback itself re-enter :auto mode (e.g. via SandboxAutoMode.enter_auto_mode!/1) before doing its DROP SCHEMA/delete_all cleanup, so it doesn't depend on the pool still being in the state provision!/2 left as a side effect of timing. Check test/support/sandbox_auto_mode.ex's own moduledoc/other usage sites for precedent before choosing. Update lib/letflow/design/iss0705-sandbox-mode-restore-fix.md's Section 1 only. Claim this handoff by setting status to COMPLETED/FAILED as normal on finishing (the handoff is already claimed conceptually via this rework note; just do the work and complete it).
acceptance_criteria: Section 1 of the design doc revised with an exact before/after shape that keeps on_exit/1's DDL cleanup working regardless of provision!/2's after-block timing
Reasoning for the chosen approach (a) vs (b) stated, referencing test/support/sandbox_auto_mode.ex's existing usage patterns
Sections 2/3 and the cleanup section left untouched

result.summary: Revised lib/letflow/design/iss0705-sandbox-mode-restore-fix.md Section 1 (tenants_test.exs) only. Root cause of ELIXIR-DEV's DBConnection.OwnershipError: provision!/2's `after`-block restore (Sandbox.mode(:manual) + checkout owned by the test process) runs synchronously, inline, the instant the wrapped fn returns -- well before the test's own on_exit/1 cleanup ever executes, since ExUnit always defers on_exit/1 to a separate OnExitHandler process running after test-process teardown, regardless of where in the source text on_exit/1 was registered. So narrowing the provision!/2 wrap's boundary (rework option (a): wrap only the DDL segment, register on_exit outside it) would NOT fix this -- moving the registration site doesn't change when the callback executes, which is always past provision!/2's restore. Chose option (b) instead: the on_exit/1 callback's body now calls SandboxAutoMode.enter_auto_mode!(Letflow.Repo) as its first line, before its existing DROP SCHEMA/delete_all cleanup, so the callback re-establishes :auto mode for itself at the moment it actually runs, independent of provision!/2's already-elapsed restore. Chose to edit the on_exit/1 callback's body in place rather than mirror identity_test.exs/role_registry_test.exs's second-callback-plus-LIFO-ordering pattern (their `enter_auto_mode!/1` on_exit registered after the real cleanup's on_exit, per that pattern's design in Sections 2/3): those two sites can't edit the cleanup on_exit directly because it's registered internally by the shared Letflow.TenantFixture.provisioned_tenant!/1 helper, whereas tenants_test.exs's on_exit is authored directly in the test and fully under this design's control, so a direct one-line edit is simpler and equally correct -- no new helper invented (enter_auto_mode!/1 already exists), and it matches sandbox_auto_mode.ex's own documented no-process-affinity guarantee for that function. End-state: pool is left in :auto mode after this on_exit/1 finishes, same accepted end-state as Sections 2/3's INV-2 (already-approved, unchanged) -- also updated INV-1's wording in Section 4 for accuracy, since the prior wording implied a restore-to-:manual end-state that no longer holds. Sections 2, 3, 5, 6 and the rest of the doc were not touched except this one INV-1 wording fix and one Section 7 table-row description update for consistency with the revised Section 1.
